description: Search Glassdoor employer profiles by company name or domain (e.g. "Printful", "Stripe", "Notion") and retrieve numeric company_id, overall rating, total review/salary/job counts, CEO approval rate, recommend-to-friend rate, business outlook, and 6 workplace sub-ratings (work-life balance, culture, career opportunities, compensation, senior management, diversity). Cost: 5 Credits / company returned (0 Credits if empty).

limit.description: Maximum matching employer profiles to return (1–50).

query.description: Employer or company name to search on Glassdoor, e.g. "Printful", "Shopify", or "Cloudflare".

name: glassdoor_companies

data.description: Normalized search results containing matching businesses, employers, destinations, or ranked restaurants with ratings and identifiers.

meta.description: Gateway billing and cache telemetry (credits_charged, credits_remaining, cache hit/miss, latency_ms).

title: Search Glassdoor Employers, Company Ratings & Sub-Ratings
